authority: Derived exclusively from Kalshi's published settlement results. No AAA-sourced series was consulted, which is what makes this usable as held-out truth against a model fitted on the AAA history.
retention_note: The public API returns settled markets for roughly the last two months only; older events resolve but carry zero markets. The earliest retrievable settlement date at generation time is 2026-05-24. More month-ends cannot be pinned from Kalshi until they occur.
